title: Trust
subtitle: 本課限定語境：trust = a firm belief in the reliability, honesty, ability, or safety of a person,
description: 本課限定語境：trust = a firm belief in the reliability, honesty, ability, or safety of a person, organization, system, idea, or arrangement · 「信任；信賴；信心」

words.note: 表示對某人、能力、制度、計劃或結果有正面把握。
words.example: The public has confidence in the new safety system.
words.exampleZh: 公眾對新的安全系統有信心。

exercises.original: Public trust in the banking system fell after the scandal.
exercises.zh: 醜聞後，公眾對銀行體系的信心下降。
exercises.upgrade: Public confidence in the banking system fell after the scandal.

options.explanation: 也可以形容對制度的深層信任，因此很有迷惑性；但在經濟／金融新聞中，public confidence in the banking system 是更標準的制度信心搭配。
banking system + fell after the scandal 是典型 public confidence 語境，重點是人們是否相信制度仍然可靠、穩健。
表示實際依靠銀行系統辦事，不等於心理上的信心下降。
表示持續支持某銀行或品牌，不是對整個制度的可信度判斷。
表示確定性，語義太強。
表示依賴程度，不表示是否信任。

exercises.original: The successful trial increased doctors' trust in the new treatment.
exercises.zh: 成功的試驗提高了醫生對新療法的信心。
exercises.upgrade: The successful trial increased doctors' confidence in the new treatment.

options.explanation: trial results can provide assurance, so this is plausible; however, the sentence describes doctors' overall level of trust in treatment effectiveness, for which confidence in is the most natural collocation.
successful trial is evidence that raises confidence in efficacy and safety.
doctors may rely on a treatment in practice, but the sentence is about their evaluation of it.
possible in a broad sense, but belief in a treatment is less idiomatic than confidence in a treatment in clinical contexts.
treatments do not normally receive loyalty in this sense.
would imply needing the treatment, not trusting its effectiveness.

exercises.original: The coach's calm leadership gave the players trust in their ability to recover.
exercises.zh: 教練冷靜的領導令球員更有信心相信自己能扭轉局面。
exercises.upgrade: The coach's calm leadership gave the players confidence in their ability to recover.

options.explanation: 球員不是在實際依賴自己的 ability，而是對成功恢復有信心。
也可表示安心，但較常由明確保證／證據提供；此句更直接是心理上的 self-confidence。
in their ability 是 confidence 的典型搭配，重點是相信自己做得到。
是忠誠，不是能力信心。
是依賴，不合。
會變成百分之百肯定，強度過高。

words.note: 表示較深層、持久或抽象的信任。
words.example: She never lost faith in her team.
words.exampleZh: 她從未失去對團隊的信任。

exercises.original: Despite years of setbacks, she never lost trust in the mission.
exercises.zh: 儘管多年受挫，她從未失去對這項使命的信念。
exercises.upgrade: Despite years of setbacks, she never lost faith in the mission.

options.explanation: 也可用，但較偏成功機率／能力判斷；years of setbacks + enduring commitment 更適合 faith 的深層信念感。
never lost + mission 表示長期、價值導向的信念，faith 非常自然。
使命不是她實際依靠來完成工作的工具。
不是來自外部保證。
她可能有信念但不代表毫無疑問。
對使命可以忠誠，但句子重點是相信它仍值得追求。

exercises.original: The community kept its trust in the recovery plan even when progress was slow.
exercises.zh: 即使進展緩慢，社區仍然對復甦計劃保持信念。
exercises.upgrade: The community kept its faith in the recovery plan even when progress was slow.

options.explanation: even when progress was slow indicates continued belief despite limited evidence of immediate success, which strongly favors faith.
the community may rely on the plan, but this sentence highlights continued belief rather than operational dependence.
would imply inability to function without the plan.
proof is evidence, not a mental state.
too absolute.
means following orders, not believing in the plan.

exercises.original: Her trust in humanity remained intact after years of difficult work.
exercises.zh: 經過多年艱苦工作後，她對人性的信念仍然沒有動搖。
exercises.upgrade: Her faith in humanity remained intact after years of difficult work.

options.explanation: 通常需要某種保證或證據來源，humanity 不適合這種搭配。
faith in humanity 是非常固定、自然的表達，指對人性基本善意的深層信念。
不是實際依賴 humanity。
不合。
不是效忠人類。
語氣過於技術化，也不是固定搭配。

words.note: 表示在實際上依靠某人、系統或資源提供支援、功能或結果。
words.example: The company has reduced its reliance on a single supplier.
words.exampleZh: 公司已減少對單一供應商的依賴。

exercises.original: The company wants to reduce its trust in a single supplier.
exercises.zh: 公司希望減少對單一供應商的依賴。
exercises.upgrade: The company wants to reduce its reliance on a single supplier.

options.explanation: 公司可能仍對供應商有信心，但策略上仍想降低依賴，因此不是同一概念。
single supplier + reduce 是典型 supply-chain dependence 語境。
太心理化、抽象。
不是保證感。
可以減少品牌忠誠，但不等於供應鏈依賴。
不是 certainty 的程度問題。

exercises.original: Modern hospitals place great trust in digital systems for patient records.
exercises.zh: 現代醫院高度依賴數碼系統管理病人紀錄。
exercises.upgrade: Modern hospitals place great reliance on digital systems for patient records.

options.explanation: for patient records 表示數碼系統是實際運作所依靠的工具，因此 reliance 最精確。
醫院未必對系統有深層信念，只是運作上高度依賴。
有信心和依賴可同時存在，但句子重點是實際功能依靠。
是欣賞。
是不懷疑。
不是忠誠關係。

exercises.original: The city's trust in imported water makes it vulnerable during supply disruptions.
exercises.zh: 城市對進口水源的依賴，使它在供應中斷時較脆弱。
exercises.upgrade: The city's reliance on imported water makes it vulnerable during supply disruptions.

options.explanation: 不是信心保證。
很接近，而且也可用；但 reliance on 更貼近「依靠某一來源」的中性策略描述，而 dependence 常更強調無法脫離。
supply disruptions + vulnerable 清楚指出實際資源依賴。
水源不是價值／信念對象。
即使不信任進口水，城市也可能仍然依賴它；兩者不同。
不合。

words.note: 表示認為某件事是真的、正確的，或認為某人／制度值得信任。
words.example: Her belief in the project remained strong despite the setbacks.
words.exampleZh: 儘管遇到挫折，她對這個項目的信念依然堅定。

exercises.original: His trust in the value of public education remained strong.
exercises.zh: 他對公共教育價值的信念一直很堅定。
exercises.upgrade: His belief in the value of public education remained strong.

options.explanation: 不是實際依靠 public education。
可表示對制度有信心，但 value of public education 更像理念／價值判斷。
belief in the value of... 是非常自然的認知／價值型搭配。
不是由保證產生的安心。
不合。
可以忠於教育理念，但不是此句主要意思。

exercises.original: The scientist's trust that the method would work was based on earlier evidence.
exercises.zh: 科學家相信這個方法會有效，而這個信念建基於早期證據。
exercises.upgrade: The scientist's belief that the method would work was based on earlier evidence.

options.explanation: that the method would work 是典型 belief-that 結構，表示認為某命題為真。
也可用於 believing a method will work，但 based on earlier evidence 使語氣更偏 evidence-based belief。
是實際依靠方法，不是「相信它有效」這個命題。
不合。
是服從。
是依賴。

exercises.original: Voters' trust in the idea that local decisions should stay local shaped the campaign.
exercises.zh: 選民相信地方事務應由地方決定，這種信念影響了競選。
exercises.upgrade: Voters' belief in the idea that local decisions should stay local shaped the campaign.

options.explanation: 通常接人、制度或能力，confidence in an idea 不如 belief 自然。
不是保證帶來的安心。
in the idea that... 是典型理念信念結構。
不是實際依靠某個 idea。
太強，表示沒有疑問。
是支持某群體／組織，不是認為理念正確。

words.meaning: 信心；安心；保證帶來的信賴
words.note: 表示因為有證據、保證、承諾或明確資訊而產生的信心與安心。
words.example: The independent audit gave investors greater assurance about the figures.
words.exampleZh: 獨立審計令投資者對數據更有信心。

exercises.original: The independent inspection gave buyers greater trust in the building's safety.
exercises.zh: 獨立檢查令買家對大樓安全性更加放心。
exercises.upgrade: The independent inspection gave buyers greater assurance about the building's safety.

options.explanation: 也很自然，而且語義接近；但 independent inspection gave... 強調外部驗證提供安心，因此 assurance 更精確。
inspection 是具體 evidence，給買家一種有根據的安心與確信。
太抽象，且通常不是由正式檢查直接「給予」。
買家不是在依靠大樓安全性。
不合。
和安全判斷無關。

exercises.original: The warranty gave customers trust that repairs would be covered.
exercises.zh: 保養令顧客相信維修費用會獲保障。
exercises.upgrade: The warranty gave customers assurance that repairs would be covered.

options.explanation: warranty 本身就是 formal guarantee，因此 give assurance that... 是最準確結構。
不是依靠維修保障來運作。
保養可能提升品牌忠誠，但不是句中直接意思。
語法可理解，但比 assurance that 弱化了 warranty 的正式保證功能。
不合。
是欣賞。

exercises.original: Clear test results gave the engineers trust that the system was stable.
exercises.zh: 清晰的測試結果令工程師對系統穩定性更有把握。
exercises.upgrade: Clear test results gave the engineers assurance that the system was stable.

options.explanation: 測試結果不是工程師實際依靠的運作資源。
faith 可以存在，但這裡有 clear test results 作明確證據，更適合 assurance。
evidence-based reassurance 是這個詞的核心。
無關。
無關。
hope 只表示希望，不代表測試結果已提供實證信心。

words.note: 表示某人或某物本身持續可靠、值得依靠的特質。
words.example: Customers value the dependability of the service.
words.exampleZh: 顧客重視這項服務的可靠性。

exercises.original: Customers trust the service because it works reliably every day.
exercises.zh: 顧客信任這項服務，因為它每天都可靠運作。
exercises.upgrade: Customers value the service's dependability because it works reliably every day.

options.explanation: 是顧客的心理狀態，不是服務本身的品質名稱。
同樣是人的信念，不是服務特質。
works reliably every day 幾乎直接定義 dependability：穩定可靠、可持續依靠。
表示顧客實際依靠服務，不是它本身的可靠性。
表示顧客持續支持服務。
不是產品品質。

exercises.original: The team's trust in their driver comes from his record of arriving on time and handling problems calmly.
exercises.zh: 團隊之所以信任司機，是因為他一向準時並冷靜處理問題。
exercises.upgrade: The driver's dependability is shown by his record of arriving on time and handling problems calmly.

options.explanation: 是團隊獲得的安心，不是司機的品質。
record of arriving on time + handling problems calmly 都是可靠性的具體證據。
是相信某事，不是個人品質。
表示團隊需要司機，不等於司機可靠。
表示忠誠。
是團隊對司機有信心，而不是司機本身可靠性的名稱。

exercises.original: The hospital chose the supplier because of its trustworthiness and consistent delivery record.
exercises.zh: 醫院因供應商值得信賴，而且交貨紀錄穩定而選擇它。
exercises.upgrade: The hospital chose the supplier because of its dependability and consistent delivery record.

options.explanation: consistent delivery record 是可靠性最直接的證據，因此 dependability 很自然。
描述醫院對供應商的依賴，不是供應商自身的品質。
是人的深層信任，不是供應商屬性。
是保證／安心，不是長期可靠表現。
是醫院的心理態度，不能直接作 supplier's quality。
是服從。

falseSynonyms.zh: 希望 ≠ trust hope 是希望好事發生；trust 是相信某人／某物可靠。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can hope a plan succeeds without actually trusting the people running it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 確定 ≠ 信任 certainty 是沒有疑問；trust 通常仍然可能存在風險。
忠誠 ≠ 信任 loyalty 是持續支持某人／組織；一個人可以忠誠，但仍對某些決策缺乏信任。
依賴 ≠ 信任 dependence 表示需要某人／某物，不一定表示信任它。
有信心 ≠ 所有 trust confidence 特別適合能力、制度或結果；對私人秘密、誠信等語境，trust 往往更自然。
深層信念 ≠ 所有日常信任 faith 通常更抽象、深層，不適合所有小型實務情境。
形容詞 vs 名詞／動詞 - trust = 信任 - trustworthy = 值得信任的
falseSynonyms.point: I trust her. She is trustworthy.

falseSynonyms.zh: 依賴 vs 可靠 - reliance = 對某人／某物的依靠 - reliable = 某人／某物可靠
